issue_being_reviewed: A package found on the van after dispatch belongs to a different route

source_evidence.evidence_summary: Lists 012 as Package Sorted to Wrong Route in the Delivery Not Attempted category.
Defines the condition as a package located on the van that should have been loaded to a different van and was discovered after dispatch.
Requires a matching delivery notation when a package cannot be delivered and shows status code, date, and work area fields.

applicability: Package is physically on the driver's van
The package should have been loaded to a different van
The discrepancy is discovered after dispatch
conditions: A package that cannot be delivered receives a notation matching the recorded status
exceptions: Predispatch manifest discrepancies are outside this record
An authorized enroute transfer is a different status and workflow
